identity.title: Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Leave It to Pikachu!

leadText:
----
(Japanese: Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Leave It to Pikachu!) is a Pokémon manga composed by Hiroshi Takase and illustrated by Makoto Mizobuchi. It was serialized in the magazine from the issue 51 (released on November 18, 2016) to the issue 65 (released on October 4, 2019). The manga utilizes quizzes and puzzles as a method of storytelling. It is 160 pages long.
